title: Anonymous Accountability
abstract: arXiv:2609.19771v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We ask how an expert panel should disclose auditable conflicts of interest when reports are named and experts care about their reputations for ability. Before sealed binary assessments are filed, an auditor commits to disclosing no orientation information, each named expert's orientation, or only the number of experts oriented in each direction; disclosure occurs after reports are locked. Holding reporting behaviour fixed, composition disclosure and individual attribution are exactly Blackwell-equivalent for learning the state at every finite panel size. Conditional on named reports remaining public, composition is minimal among state-lossless disclosures of orientations: every lossless public message must make the composition recoverable together with the reports. translated_abstract: 我们探讨在报告署名且专家在意自身能力声誉的情况下，专家委员会应如何披露可审计的利益冲突信息。在密封的二元评估提交之前，审计者承诺采取以下三种披露方式之一：不披露任何倾向信息、披露每位具名专家的倾向，或仅披露各方向上专家的数量；披露在报告锁定之后进行。在固定报告行为的前提下，就每个有限规模委员会的状态学习而言，构成披露与个体归属在Blackwell意义上完全等价。在具名报告保持公开的条件下，构成是所有状态无损的倾向披露中最小的：任何无损的公开信息都必须使倾向构成能够连同报告一起被恢复。然而，两者产生的激励却截然不同。在接近混同的大委员会极限下，个体归属下遵循与自身倾向相反的证据所获得的局部职业回报……
tldr: 本文研究专家委员会的利益冲突披露机制，发现在状态信息层面仅披露专家倾向构成与逐一归属个体在Blackwell意义上等价且构成披露是最小的无损披露，但两种披露方式对专家职业激励的影响却截然不同。
en_tdlr: This paper studies conflict-of-interest disclosure in expert panels, showing that disclosing only the composition of expert orientations is Blackwell-equivalent to—and minimal among—state-lossless individual attributions for learning the state, yet the two disclosure regimes create sharply different career incentives.
